# Tack, tack!

> Tack, tack! (tacktackstudio.com, @tacktackstudio) is an independent shop in Hong Kong for curated design classics from around the world: furniture, lighting and objects, new and pre-loved. Hong Kong stock includes Isamu Noguchi AKARI, DULTON and &Tradition lighting, plus Yoshitomo Nara prints. Every price is shown on the site in Hong Kong dollars. Enquiries and sales happen over WhatsApp; pickup is by appointment, with delivery anywhere in Hong Kong. The site is in English and Traditional Chinese (/zh/).

## Facts
- Who we are: Tack, tack! is an independent shop in Hong Kong for curated design classics from around the world: furniture, lighting and objects, new and pre-loved.
- What's listed now: Pieces from Isamu Noguchi AKARI, &Tradition, DULTON, Heller (Anna Dawson), HAY and Yoshitomo Nara, plus a Japan-made rental-friendly wall hook (pre-order, set of 2) and a white solid wood picture frame for the Nara prints. AKARI, DULTON, Heller, the HAY trays, the Nara prints, the wall hook and the picture frame are brand new. The &Tradition lamps include brand-new and pre-loved pieces. Every price is shown on the site in Hong Kong dollars.
- How to buy: Message us on WhatsApp (+852 6507 0791) or email hello@tacktackstudio.com. There's no online checkout: we confirm availability, send extra photos if you like, and share payment details.
- Payment: FPS, PayMe, bank transfer or cash, and PayPal for overseas buyers.
- Pickup & delivery: Pickup is by appointment (we share the address when you book), or we deliver anywhere in Hong Kong, quoted before you pay.
- Holds: Under HK$1,500 we take full payment. From HK$1,500 to HK$9,999, a 30% deposit holds a piece for up to 7 days; from HK$10,000, a 20% deposit (min. HK$3,000) holds it for up to 14 days.
- New pieces: Every Thursday. Follow @tacktackstudio on Instagram or Threads.
- Brand name: Tack, tack! (tacktackstudio.com, @tacktackstudio). Spelled exactly, with the comma and exclamation mark. Website: https://tacktackstudio.com/
- Contact: WhatsApp +852 6507 0791 (https://wa.me/85265070791), email hello@tacktackstudio.com, Instagram and Threads @tacktackstudio
- Buy & consign: Moving or downsizing? We buy and consign design pieces. WhatsApp us a photo (https://wa.me/85265070791).
- Returns: all sales are final; if a piece is materially different from its description when you view it, the deposit is refunded in full.

## Brands
- [Isamu Noguchi AKARI](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/isamu-noguchi-akari/): AKARI is the series of paper light sculptures Isamu Noguchi began in 1951, after visiting Gifu, a Japanese town known for its paper lanterns. Every shade is washi paper stretched over bamboo ribbing, and each one is still made by hand by Ozeki & Co. in Gifu. Every listing here carries an honest condition grade and real measurements. Cord add-on and installation available; we quote them on WhatsApp.
- [DULTON](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/dulton/): DULTON is a Japanese homeware brand known for taking everyday, utilitarian objects and making them more fun to live with. Its Double Face Clock borrows from the two-sided clocks hung in train stations and public buildings, redrawn as a long, low rectangle that suits homes with lower ceilings. We carry the Double Face clock in grey and green. Grey is in stock in Hong Kong. The next green batch is arriving soon, and pre-order is open (Japan air freight). Limited free delivery applies to in-stock orders when we offer it. Rental-friendly: stand one on a shelf, or mount it on the wall.
- [Heller](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/heller/): Heller is the American design brand behind Swell, the wave-shaped wall catchall by designer and California surfer Anna Dawson. Heller spotted her prototype at WantedDesign in 2022 and launched it at ICFF in 2023, in collaboration with MoMA; the smaller Swell Mini followed in 2025. Both hang on the wall and hold everyday things, from coats and bags to keys and glasses, which makes them a practical fit for a Hong Kong entryway.

- [&Tradition](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/andtradition/): Danish design brand. In stock: Verner Panton's Flowerpot VP9 portable lamps (1968), the Mist AP15 pendant by All the Way to Paris, and Signe Hytte's Journey SHY2 wall lamp (2018). Condition grades are on each page. The Mist and Journey prices are under retail. Installation for those two is available as an add-on.
- [Yoshitomo Nara](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/yoshitomo-nara/): Japanese artist. Two prints, both brand new: Green Eyes (2002) at HK$298 and Untitled (Eye Patch) (2012) at HK$328. Each is 28 × 36 cm and unframed.
- [HAY](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/hay/): Danish design brand. Two silicone ice cube trays are in stock, both brand new: Ice Cube Tray XXL in Ice blue (2025SS) at HK$138, and Ice Cube Tray Square XL in Peach, with tag, at HK$148. Official retail on HAY.nl is €25, about HK$228. Buy both together for HK$268.

## Questions
- Where can I buy AKARI lamps in Hong Kong? Tack, tack! stocks curated new and pre-loved Isamu Noguchi AKARI in Hong Kong, including 30A and 55D (the 45D has sold). Enquire on WhatsApp (+852 6507 0791) or email hello@tacktackstudio.com. Pickup is by appointment, or we deliver in Hong Kong.
- Is the DULTON Double Face clock in grey or green in stock in Hong Kong? Grey is in stock in Hong Kong and was shipped from Japan. The next green batch is arriving soon, and pre-order is open (Japan air freight). Limited free delivery applies to in-stock orders while the offer runs. WhatsApp us (+852 6507 0791).
- Where can I buy Yoshitomo Nara prints in Hong Kong? Tack, tack! has two brand-new prints: Green Eyes (2002) at HK$298 (SKU TT-NAR-0001) and Untitled (Eye Patch) (2012) at HK$328 (SKU TT-NAR-0002). Both are 28 × 36 cm, unframed. Enquire on WhatsApp (+852 6507 0791).
- How does WhatsApp buying work? Message us with the piece name or SKU. We confirm availability and send photos, then you pay by FPS, PayMe, bank transfer or cash (PayPal for overseas buyers). Pickup is by appointment, or we quote delivery. There's no online checkout.
- 香港哪裡可以買 AKARI 燈？ Tack, tack! 有精選全新及二手野口勇 AKARI，香港現貨（包括 30A、55D（45D 已售出））。WhatsApp（+852 6507 0791）或電郵 hello@tacktackstudio.com 查詢。可預約自取，或香港送貨。
- DULTON 雙面鐘灰色或綠色有香港現貨嗎？ 灰色是香港現貨，由日本直送。綠色下一批即將到貨，仍可預購（日本空運，到港後寄出）。限時免費送貨適用於現貨。WhatsApp（+852 6507 0791）。
- 香港哪裡可以買奈良美智海報？ Tack, tack! 現貨兩張全新海報：Green Eyes（2002）HK$298（貨號 TT-NAR-0001）、Untitled (Eye Patch)（2012）HK$328（貨號 TT-NAR-0002）。兩張都是 28 × 36 cm，不連相框。WhatsApp（+852 6507 0791）。
- WhatsApp 怎樣購買？ 傳訊息時註明貨品名稱或貨號。我們會確認存貨並傳送相片，然後以 FPS、PayMe、銀行轉帳或現金付款（海外買家可用 PayPal），再安排預約自取或報價送貨。網站不設網上付款。
